access.notes: Open-source all-electron FLAPW code. An equivalent FLAPW implementation may be used.
Tool for locating extremal cross-sectional areas from band-structure eigenvalues. An equivalent tool may be substituted.

Space group Immm (#71), lattice constants a=7.033 Å, b=9.677 Å, c=4.021 Å. Atomic positions: La (2a) (0,0,0), Ni (2c) (0.5,0,0), Al1 (4g) (0,y,0) with y=0.358, Al2 (4h) (0,0.5,z) with z=0.25. Used to build DFT input.
